fleetHealthHint: Every till and server reporting to the hub
fleetHint: Every installation, judged from both heartbeats. Red is ours to fix; offline is usually the client's power or network.
makeDefaultHint: Every installation following the default starts moving to it at its next check-in. Pinned and paused installations stay where they are.
noAgent: This installation predates the supervisor and cannot be updated remotely.
noInstallationsHint: They appear here after the first check-in.
noLanURLs: This installation reported no routable address of its own.
nodeMissingHint: It may have been replaced by a seed, which gives an installation a new identity.
releasesHint: The default is what every installation without a pinned target moves to. Agents update one at a time and roll back on a failed health check.
retireHint: For an installation that will never exchange again: an abandoned training laptop, a replaced till. The hub refuses its exchanges from now on and no reset waits for it. This cannot be undone — the device can only come back by re-enrolling from a seed.
search: Client, local name or node id
updateSettingsHint: Pin this installation to a release, or let it follow the default. Pausing stops it updating at all — for a client mid-service or under investigation.
